alerts.headline: Nilkamal shares zoom 20% after Q2 net profit doubles to Rs 68 crore
alerts.summary: The stock opened at Rs 1798.70 apiece on the BSE before climbing to its upper circuit level. It then rallied 19.99 percent to hit the upper circuit of Rs 2116.10.
